intentions.title: Give new users a runnable, opinionated Next.js + Barkpark website from a single scaffold command, not a blank SDK
intentions.evidence: package.json.tmpl wires next dev/build/start, barkpark generate codegen, and a tsx seed script alongside @barkpark/core, @barkpark/nextjs, @barkpark/react as first-class deps — the template is a complete working app skeleton, not a snippet.

intentions.title: Make the read path correct by construction: cache tags, draft-mode bypass, and URL scoping all derive from one createBarkparkServer instance
intentions.evidence: lib/barkpark.ts comment: 'Every helper below delegates to it — do NOT hand-roll fetch here or the read/write cache tags drift and revalidation silently no-ops (permanent stale content).' getDocs/getDoc/getDocBySlug all route through barkparkFetch.

intentions.title: Support both single-tenant (flat /v1/...) and multi-workspace (/w/.../p/.../v1/...) Barkpark servers from the same starter without code forks
intentions.evidence: barkpark.config.ts.tmpl comments explain the flat-path default vs scoped workspace+project path; seeds/seed.ts computes SCOPE from BARKPARK_WORKSPACE/BARKPARK_PROJECT env vars with the same fallback logic.

intentions.title: Demonstrate schema-driven content modeling (author/page/post) as a copy-paste-ready reference for real site builders
intentions.evidence: schemas/author.ts, schemas/page.ts, schemas/post.ts define document schemas (slug, richText, reference, image, arrayOf) mirroring Barkpark's schema v2 field types.

intentions.title: Let a fresh scaffold be immediately demoable with realistic content — no empty-state dead end
intentions.evidence: seeds/seed.ts seeds 2 authors, 3 pages, 3 posts with Portable Text bodies and publishes them via the mutate API in one `pnpm seed` run against a local docker-compose Barkpark instance.

intentions.title: Keep the starter's tooling (Next.js, Tailwind, PostCSS) invisible boilerplate so users focus on content, not config
intentions.evidence: next.config.mjs, postcss.config.js, tailwind.config.ts are minimal template-only configs bundled alongside the CMS-facing files, present but low-importance (4) relative to barkpark.ts/config/package.json.
